profile.headline: Software Engineer 2 at Garmin International
profile.summary: Alumni, B.S. recipient, and undergraduate thesis author from Barrett, the Honors College, and the Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering of Arizona State University. Current Software Engineer 2 at Garmin International with 3 years of experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
- Lead software engineer for Garmin's flight-deck configuration tool with 300+ monthly active users (internal), representing $3M in internal engineering support that contributes to $500M in flight-deck revenue (2024).
- Implemented RabbitMQ messaging queue to improve service reliability under load, supporting another 30 monthly active users (internal) and contributing to the tool qualification effort behind Garmin SmartCharts.
- Continuation of previous internal tooling support.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed internal tooling software for the production of the G3000 PRIME Integrated Flight Deck and AXIS flight displays.
- Integrated AWS S3 storage with existing workflows to support product distribution across internal and external clients.
- Contributed to the software certification effort for the AXIS flight displays by writing C module tests.
- Maintained production web services with Kubernetes.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Provided front and backend support for the Garmin in-house tool suite, operating in the Node, React.js, and MySQL tech stack.
- Tracked application builds across Jenkins and Helm, using Docker Desktop and Kubernetes to debug production services.

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
- Utilized a variety of research tools including Python + Pandas and QGIS to study, visualize, and predict Arctic Sea ice thickness and freeboard.

- Achieved project approval from the European Space Agency, allowing for the development of a convolutional neural network using sponsored data.

positions.title: ASU 101 Section Leader
positions.description: - Mentored 17 freshman computer science students through college transitioning.

educations.schoolName: Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering at Arizona State University

projects.title: Barret Undergraduate Thesis
projects.description: - Undergraduate thesis for Barrett, the Honors College. A study of corroborating expansive Synthetic Aperture Radar imaging with localized laser altimetry.

projects.title: Visualizing the MLB 2023 Postseason with D3.js
projects.description:
- A personal topic chosen for the semester course project for CSE 478 (Data Visualization)
- Visualized team composition and performance of MLB teams to better explain the context of the MLB 2023 Postseason
